notes.title: Full Version Released! 🔥
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Players! The time has come! 🔥[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]El Dorado: The Golden City Builder is officially available on Steam! 🥳[/b][/h2]

[h3]Thanks to your commitment over the last few days, we have increased the [b]launch discount to 15%[/b] - thank you for your support 🤝[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1451470/El_Dorado_The_Golden_City_Builder/

[previewyoutube=FZ9Tf4ewk_4;full][/previewyoutube]
It was an amazing journey through the game's entire development, from Playtest, to the demo, Prologue, and now the release of the full version of the game. At every step, your feedback was extremely valuable and helped us choose the right direction for the further development of El Dorado, for which we are extremely grateful!

After several months of hard work, the game is now fully ready and you can enjoy the gameplay in the full version of the game. The entire team worked extremely hard on the production, we wanted the game to meet your expectations.

[h3][b]Please remember that you can leave us your feedback on Steam or on our Discord 📝[/b][/h3]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1451470/discussions/0/6579276970677722487/]📖 | SUGGESTIONS & FEEDBACK[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1451470/discussions/0/6579276970677722362/]🐛 | BUGS & PROBLEMS[/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/2YPZ6fDBsh]📋 | DISCORD[/url]

Now, take on the role of a leader even the Gods will bow to. Offers sacrifice to earn their favor, but tread carefully, don't lose yourself in pride. Forge the most powerful empire on the Yucatan peninsula. From a humble settlement, build a bustling city dripping with gold. Manage resources, build structures, and maintain the balance between prosperity and the divine.

[url=https://discord.gg/2YPZ6fDBsh][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/5d85522441c744d2eea4300ae6a297bb196c2da2.png[/img][/url]

Have fun!
El Dorado Team

notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Village Leaders! [/b][/h1]

The premiere of El Dorado: The Golden City Builder is just around the corner but before it happens we’d like to treat you to yet another update in the Prologue! 💪

[h3][b]Play the Full Version on June 17, 2024 at 5:00 pm CEST [/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1451470/El_Dorado_The_Golden_City_Builder/

This is the fruit of your feedback and our hard work in providing even better gameplay experience than before. 

Without further ado, we hope that the changes we bring will make for a nice appetizer for what’s to come in just a few days! 👍

[list][*]chore: introduction of a new area of range so that it is visible above the trees.
[*]chore: introduction of the ability to reconfigure the keyboard to the options.
[*]chore: adding an indicator to show paused buildings.
[*]chore: adding more UI animations.
[*]chore: further optimization
[*]chore: changes to gameplay balance.
[*]bugfix: sometimes buildings do not detect that they have been connected to a road.
[*]bugfix: tooltips don't always work.
[*]bugfix: crash when very many roads have been built.
[*]bugfix: temple residents stay in the same place after moving a building.
[*]bugfix: deposits are not highlighted.
[*]bugfix: when there are a lot of warehouses on the map then the game freezes.
[*]bugfix: sometimes the game freezes for a few seconds.
[*]bugfix: corrections in translations[/list]

See you soon,
El Dorado: The Golden City Builder Team

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Village Leaders![/b][/h2]
[h3]Thank you for the fact that so many of you decided to play the prologue of our game and leave us a lot of very pertinent feedback. [/h3]

Thanks to you, we've been able to spend the last few days making fixes to make the game easier for you and improving various systems. 

[h3]We are still working hard on optimizing the game to make it run more smoothly, but we have already fixed some of the bugs you reported. [/h3]

Fixes: 

[list]
[*] Improves tutorial and adds necessary arrows
[*] Improves explanation of shrines and temples mechanics
[*] Adds highlighting of protected buildings when player builds shrines or selects shrine
[*] Bugfix: new buildings not connecting to road and warehouses even they are in range and built properly
[*] Bugfix: loading map with buildings on level 3 was crashing the game on loading screen
[/list]

Thank you for your support!
El Dorado : The Golden City Builder Team
